generations.name: First generation (MEB)
generations.notes: Launch, Q4 50 e-tron quattro and Sportback, plus RWD Q4 40 (US). 82 kWh gross / 77 kWh usable; DC 150 kW on quattro (125-135 kW on RWD). Confidence: medium-high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audi_Q4_e-tron ; https://www.cars.com/articles/2024-audi-q4-e-tron-review-not-too-hot-not-too-cold-486630

generations.name: 2024 update
generations.notes: Same 82/77 kWh pack, new APP550 rear motor, DC up to 175 kW on quattro (135 kW RWD); "Q4 55 e-tron quattro" replaced "Q4 50" partway through MY2024, so some 2024 ratings ("Q4 50 e-tron quattro", "Q4 Sportback 50 e-tron quattro", US "Q4 40") are launch hardware: split those 2024 rows by name, not year. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.audi-mediacenter.com/en/press-releases/update-for-the-audi-q4-e-tron-more-range-more-efficiency-more-emotions-15594 ; https://insideevs.com/news/711913/2024-audi-q4-etron-55/ ; https://www.automoblog.com/2024-audi-q4-55-e-tron/
